blocks.text: A reliable travel coffee tumbler that keeps your drink ready from the first sip to the last, wherever your day takes you.
Double-wall vacuum insulation holds coffee hot for 6 hours and cold drinks for 12 hours.
Ceramic-coated interior keeps flavors clean without any metallic taste.
Natural bamboo lid with slide closure stays secure and easy to sip from on the move.
400 ml size fits most car cup holders for smooth commuting.
Crafted from 18/8 stainless steel with double-wall vacuum insulation and a ceramic-coated interior for lasting performance.
Ideal for US commuters and remote workers who need hot coffee or cold drinks that stay ready between home, office, and the road.
The bamboo slide lid seals tightly so it won’t leak or crack, while the ceramic coating and vacuum insulation stop metallic taste and rapid heat loss.
Hand-wash only to keep the finish and lid in top shape. Priced at 26 USD.
